source.thirdPartyModules: excluded (a pristine nginx OSS tarball contains none)

referenceBuild.name: nginx.org official 1.29.6 Linux package
referenceBuild.note: The nginx.org official package is the pinned differential oracle. A bare `./configure` does not build ssl/http2/http3/stream/mail, so referenceBuild means "compiled into the declared reference build", not "present in a default build".
